reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: The supervisor's forwarding proxy records api.runtime.response_interrupted and leaves the response incomplete when the API worker dies mid-stream, instead of raising into uvicorn's unhandled-exception traceback. Selected: the runtime HTTP proxy suite with a new mid-response regression.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: viewers still see a truncated response as before.
